why: Tests step for slice S5 of docs/plan/quests/port-scripts-0113-PLAN.md, redact.sh's port and the first Lock service, on branch fabrikalfa/port-0113-s05 (the plan branch plus S1). redact.test.ts keeps all seven old K19 laws with their titles, generators, seed and run counts, now through redact.ts's command line on the real layer redact/RedactFs.ts over a disk in memory (FileSystem.layerNoop), a ChildProcessSpawner in memory and sys/LockTest.ts; the two old scenarios became properties over a generated secret so they pass fabrika/law-shape with their old titles. Four laws are new: the plan's three S5 rows (a secret under up to six layers of JSON and URL escapes and a token under JSON escapes is replaced whole, 100 runs, coverage of six changing layers required; --run scrubs both files before the .npmrc restore and a failed scrub deletes them, nine failure points each reached, 20 runs, which also holds that the child gets only a handed-over environment with no secret, blank npm configs, the prompt as stdin and runs under the Lock; two to four runs in one folder never overlap the swap, 30 runs) and one format law on RedactTest (only `redacted N` is printed, the exit code is the scrub's or the command's, and --run hands every word after -- to the command unchanged, 50 runs). All eleven are red for one reason: Cannot find module './redact.ts'. New test files: redact/RedactTest.ts (a Recorder layer) and sys/LockTest.ts (a Ref of held names); .agents/tsconfig.json includes the new files. redact.sh and its NOT_YET_PORTED line are left for a short tests commit after the build, as the brief asks.

note: Cloud twin tests step, one session, no subagents.
